5273.title: Composer service tier crosses provider selections
5273.rootCauseOneLine: A single provider-agnostic composer service-tier preference survives provider switches and becomes an explicit Fast request for the destination provider.
5273.proposedFix: Decide provider-specific eligibility versus provider-scoped remembered tiers, including default inheritance and existing saved-choice semantics, before changing settings or persistence.
5273.caveats: Reproduced the real composer hook twice with isolated catalogue fixtures. No paid provider turns, browser screenshots, or live database/event-log verification; those downstream paths were inspected statically. Full app typecheck hits an unrelated existing attachment-preview type error. Reproduction source and output are inline in the HTML.
